policy: Exact university-verified source-score exceptions preserve published results. Two distinct official university sources may authorize a narrowly scoped score correction with a full pinned-baseline Elo replay. Independently verified one-day date-only corrections also require replay. Any unmatched identity, score or date conflict remains fail-closed.

exceptions.explanation: Home institution's women's soccer game report explicitly documents a 1-0 final and winning goal with 1.7 seconds left. University's separate men's soccer report documents a 3-1 final on the same date against the same opponent. Do not overwrite the independently supported women's 1-0 Elo result with a potentially cross-feed or stale scoreboard score.

Hanover and Earlham official men's soccer recaps both document a 3–1 Earlham win on Tuesday November 3, 2026; the ledger entered November 4 from an earlier scoreboard date. Correct only the calendar date, preserving game ID, identity, score and one Elo application.
Official NYU and Middlebury reports independently confirm a 3-1 Middlebury victory on Nov 14; keep NCAA ledger home NYU 1, away Middlebury 3 rather than the transient scoreboard's 1-2.

Independent official box scores from Eastern Kentucky and Abilene Christian establish EKU 1-3 ACU in the Nov 14 UAC final. The published Elo ledger inverted the scores (3-1); accept the corrected NCAA source score, replay all Elo ratings chronologically, and preserve audit provenance.
